messages:
Samir Patel: Async check-in for NimbleLend renewal escalation — quick standup. What I did / blockers / today

Lia Chen: What I did: triaged webhook error spike, found 503s from customer endpoint + our retry logic not backoff'ing properly.
Blocker: need a short-lived patch to add exponential backoff and jitter into retries.
Today: will push patch to staging and run 30m soak. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Tariq Malik: What I did: adjusted routing policy to route traffic to regional fallback pool for NimbleLend while we stabilize. Confirmed capacity in eu-west-2 for peak hours.
Blocker: console rollout needs a quick approval from infra to change global policy TTL.
Today: will ping infra and prepare rollback plan.

Maria Gomez: What I did: spoke with account — they reported embedding quality dip after the last canary switch. Looks like 8-bit quantized candidate gave divergence in similarity scores.
Blocker: need a reproducible eval set from CS to compare models.
Today: will run eval on both model variants and share diffs by EOD.

CS Oncall Bot: [alert] 1767779420 - NimbleLend webhook error rate > 5% for 22m, spikes correlated with 13:10-13:30 UTC. Auto-fallback activated.

Samir Patel: Lia — estimate how long for staging soak and can we fast-track to prod if green? Also, Jordan @Jordan (AM) can you set customer expectation for a ~2-4 hour mitigation window?

Lia Chen: Staging patch builds in ~25m, soak 30m. If no regressions, we can promote with a phased canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%) in ~2 hours. Will add feature flag. :white_check_mark:

Jordan (AM): On it, will message the customer that we're applying a mitigative patch and expect rollback/complete fix window 3 hours. Keeping them in the loop now.

Tariq Malik: Infra approval got pinged. If they approve TTL change, I can flip routing in 10m and reduce pressure on the primary endpoint.

Maria Gomez: I'll post the eval results as soon as I have them. If quantization caused the drift, we should revert canary and run smaller-quant steps.

Samir Patel: Quick nit — Lia, include the exact retry snippet you plan to deploy so eng-sre can review quickly. Example we discussed earlier:

```python
# simple backoff pseudocode
for attempt in range(1, max_attempts+1):
    try:
        post_webhook(payload)
        break
    except HTTPError as e:
        sleep(min(base * 2**(attempt-1) + random_jitter(), max_backoff))
        continue
```

Lia Chen: Yup that's basically it, will paste the actual patch in code review. Linking PR when ready.

CS Oncall Bot: [deploy-bot] PR 4321 opened by liachen -> staging. Tests: unit 128/128, integration 14/14.

Samir Patel: Thanks team. If anything blocks promotion, drop a one-line update here. Will follow up after the soak. :handshake:
